flagged_irregularities.area: Yu Garden Off-Peak Ticket & Shanghai Museum People's Square
flagged_irregularities.legacy_claim: Legacy root misquoted Yu Garden off-peak fee as ¥40 and listed People's Square as hosting permanent galleries.
flagged_irregularities.verified_finding: Official yugarden.com.cn sets Dec 1–Mar 31 off-peak adult admission at ¥30 (¥60 for 2), closed Mondays. Official shanghaimuseum.net states People's Square hosts only the ticketed Americas exhibition (Jul 2026–Nov 2027) while permanent galleries sit at Shanghai Museum East (closed Tuesdays).
flagged_irregularities.action_taken: Updated both venues with exact official notices.

questions.question: Which hotel budget tier fits your preference: Andaz Xintiandi ($1,376.21 room-only), Langham Xintiandi ($2,291.93 incl. breakfast + 2★ T'ang Court), or Peninsula Shanghai (CNY 20,119.33 direct promo incl. breakfast, deadline Dec 7, 2026)?
questions.why: Peninsula's 15% promo closes Dec 7, 2026, and Andaz's $1,376.21 rate is non-refundable.

questions.question: Do you want 7 nights (Feb 15–22, covering Lantern Festival Feb 20) or 10–14 nights inside Feb 15–Mar 23?
questions.why: Peninsula's Feb 15–Mar 8 window is 13.8% cheaper than Mar 8–23, and longer stays accommodate Disneyland + Suzhou/Hangzhou rail trips.

questions.question: Are you flying US → Shanghai → third country/region (eligible for 240-hour NIA visa-free transit) or US → Shanghai → US (requires standard Chinese visa)?
questions.why: Must confirm routing before booking non-refundable flights or hotels.

questions.question: Which 2–4 Michelin reservations are must-haves (e.g., 3★ Taian Table ¥5,176–5,776, 2★ T'ang Court ¥888/¥2,288, 2★ Da Vittorio, 2★ Bao Li Xuan ¥3,576–5,176)?
questions.why: Top tasting-menu counters release bookings 30–60 days ahead and have strict closed-day rules (Mon/Sun).

questions.question: King bed vs. two Queen/Twin beds?
questions.why: Langham/Andaz/Sukhothai/Ritz-Carlton verified quotes are 1 King; EDITION offers 1 King or 2 Queens; Peninsula offers King or Twin.

questions.question: Are there dietary restrictions (seafood/crustacean/shellfish, alcohol pairings, vegetarian)?
questions.why: Several Huangpu/Bund icons are Cantonese/Ningbo seafood-focused, while 2★ Fu He Hui & Bib Gong De Lin are vegetarian.

questions.question: Is Shanghai Disneyland a must-do given it sits at the outer ~1h edge of Metro Line 11?
questions.why: Requires a full day plus advance real-name passport ticket registration.

questions.question: Do you want an optional 1-day high-speed rail trip (Suzhou or Hangzhou) via 12306?
questions.why: Fits cleanly in a 10–14 night window; tight in a 7-night Michelin-focused itinerary.

questions.question: Do you already have Alipay / WeChat Pay linked to an international card and eSIM/roaming ready?
questions.why: Needed for Shanghai Metro QR rides, Yu Garden mini-program tickets, and restaurant deposits.

questions.question: Are you traveling via PVG (Pudong) or SHA (Hongqiao)?
questions.why: Affects arrival transfer choice (Maglev/Metro Line 2 from PVG vs Line 2/10 from SHA).

suggestions.title: Lock a refundable Feb 15–22 base hotel immediately & decide on Peninsula before Dec 7
suggestions.detail: Book Langham Xintiandi ($2,291.93 incl. breakfast, free cancel until Feb 10) or Peninsula promo (CNY 20,119.33 before Dec 7) so you hold prime Huangpu inventory while keeping flexibility.

suggestions.title: Pair Huangpu hotel stay with closed-day-aware restaurant & museum blocks
suggestions.detail: Never put Yu Garden, Shanghai Museum People's Square, T'ang Court, or Da Vittorio on Monday, and never put Shanghai Museum East on Tuesday.

suggestions.title: Use dim sum lunch sets at 1★/2★ hotels to manage dining budget
suggestions.detail: Yi Long Court (¥788.22 for 2) and T'ang Court (¥888 for 2) deliver starred Cantonese craft at a fraction of evening tasting-menu spend.

suggestions.title: Verify remaining 38 starred addresses & live Feb 2027 Amap/Metro transit times from local mobile app
suggestions.detail: Because shmetro.com failed from the sandbox, run an Amap / Apple Maps transit check in Shanghai or pre-trip to confirm minute-by-minute door-to-door timings.

suggestions.title: Add Lantern Festival (Feb 20, 2027) evening booking alert on Yu Garden mini-program
suggestions.detail: Official site publishes Spring Festival / Lantern Festival evening hours separately by notice.

suggestions.title: Pre-book Taian Table 30–60 days out (Tue–Sat 18:00/20:00 seatings only)
Confirm private bathroom text & airport transfer perks on checkout screen
suggestions.detail: Even on 5-star MICHELIN listings, save a screenshot of room bed & bath specs at booking.
